# HyprlandIpcManager

> **File:** `services/compositor/HyprlandIpcManager.qml` · **Docs:** see [docs/dev](../../README.md)

Requests on Hyprland's request socket, as hyprctl makes them but without a process each: what Quickshell.Hyprland doesn't cover (options, Lua evals, binds, devices, layers, the cursor, reloads). Only the Hyprland* services use it; the rest of the shell asks HyprlandManager. Hyprland answers one request per connection, then closes it. Each request gets its own socket, closed by us as soon as the reply is complete (HyprReply.complete): Quickshell warns when the other side closes first. HyprlandIpcManager.json("clients", clients => …) // j/clients HyprlandIpcManager.evalLua("hl.config({ … })", reply => …) // "ok" or the error

### Functions

- `request(command, callback)`: Sends `command` as hyprctl would ("j/clients", "reload", "switchxkblayout all next") and calls back with the reply, or null when Hyprland didn't answer (no socket, or nothing within 5 s)
- `json(command, callback)`: `command`'s JSON reply ("clients" asks j/clients), or null
- `jsonBatch(commands, callback)`: Several JSON replies in one request (["getoption general:gaps_out", "animations"]), each a value or null
- `evalLua(lua, callback)`: Runs a Lua chunk in Hyprland (hl.*) and calls back with its reply, trimmed: "ok", or the error ("" when Hyprland didn't answer)
